paragraphs.text: Hello, Bradley Insurance claims department. My name is Kevin. How can I help you?
Oh, hello. I'd like to make a claim on my insurance.
Is that motor insurance?
No, household.

The type of insurance that the woman is claiming for is household, so household has been written in the space. Now we shall begin. You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time. Listen carefully and answer questions one to five.
Hello, Bradley Insurance claims department. My name is Kevin. How can I help you?
Oh, hello. I'd like to make a claim on my insurance.
Is that motor insurance?
No, household.
Okay. Do you have your policy records, please?
Yes. It's JXY465773.
Okay, thank you very much. And can you tell me whose name is on the policy?
It's in the name of Tom Proudfoot. That's P-R-O-U-D-F-O-O-T.
That's fine. And am I speaking to his wife?
Yes, that's me.
Okay. So I'm looking at your details now on the screen. And could you just confirm your address for me?
It's 98,Crown Road.
Is that Crown as in we're working on Queensways?
Yes, that's right.
And that's in Frampton?
Yes.
That's all fine then. And one last check to confirm your identity. Can you tell me your postcode?
Yes, it's PG32BK.
Okay. Well, I see from our records that you've previously made a claim. Is that correct?
Oh. Oh, yes, that's right. Someone took my son's bicycle even though he'd left it locked up in the garage. But I suppose we were lucky they didn't steal the car too.
And that was within the last twelve months?
Yes, it must be... How long since it happened? Must be 10 months now.
Okay.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.
Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
So that's all the details I need so far. Thanks. Now, let's get on to the present claim. Can you tell me exactly what the problem is?
Well, we went away at the weekend to see my parents, and when we came back last night and opened the front door, there was water everywhere inside the house, and it's done a lot of damage.
Oh dear. Can you tell me exactly what the damage was?
Well, we went into the hall first, and when we looked up, we couldn't believe it. The ceiling had actually come down in places. Water was coming through it from above.
Was there damage anywhere else?

Yes. We went upstairs to the bathroom. There it was the floor that had been affected. Oh, and that wasn't all. When we looked in the bedroom, we found that the water had got in there too. Luckily, the carpet was okay, but it had stained the wall. It's a real mess.
Yes, it's amazing the damage water can do. And where had it actually come from in the first place?
Well, in the end, we found out the water was leaking from a pipe upstairs in the bathroom. It must have been going on for quite a long time to have caused all that damage.
Right. Well, that's all the information I need for the time being. I'm going to arrange for someone to come over and inspect the damage as soon as possible. Uh, let's see. How about this Tuesday?
Uh, that'd be best. I'm out later today and Wednesday.
Fine.
The house is a bit difficult to find because the main door is at the side rather than the front. There's a supermarket just across the street.
Okay, thanks. I'll make a note of that. Goodbye then.
Goodbye.
That is the end of section one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
